d:
The Ramayan is more than an epic. It is a journey through places, landscapes and cultures that have preserved its legacy across generations.
On this edition of Wings, we trace the Ramayan trail across India and Sri Lanka, visiting destinations associated with the life and journey of Lord Ram and Goddess Sita. From Ayodhya to Chitrakoot and beyond, we explore the landmarks, traditions and stories that connect these places to one of the world's most enduring epics.
